independent_verification.method: fresh curl download of the official archive into a temporary directory, then local sha256sum/md5sum and in-archive PKG-INFO inspection; NO archive retained in the donor cache or any workspace store

donor_cache_state.note: No NumPy archive was staged by the donor. This attestation pins the official upstream sdist hash; a future guarded build must stage exactly this archive in the build context and fail closed on sha256sum -c. No new cache was created on marceline-dev.

compatibility.scipy: 1.2.3 sdist sha256 ecbe6413ca90b8e19f8475bfa303ac001e81b04ec600d17fa7f816271f7cca57; official metadata requires_dist numpy (>=1.8.2) and requires_python >=2.7,!=3.0.*,!=3.1.*,!=3.2.*,!=3.3.*
compatibility.note: NumPy 1.16.6 is the last upstream release declaring CPython 2.7 support. PyPI also lists DoS advisories PYSEC-2021-856/857 fixed only in 1.19+, which cannot be used on py2.7; document as an accepted, bounded risk for this NONQUALIFYING experimental tool, not silently waived.

non_actions: No podman build/run, no container, no frozen MiCall edit, no upstream/main write, no registry/receipt mutation, no additional large cache.
